hero.title:
Say 'Plan My Day.'
Watch It Fill.
hero.description: HABOS analyzes your tasks, priorities, and deadlines — then proposes a full schedule. You approve before anything moves.

body: The calendar doesn't just display your schedule — it's an intelligent scheduling engine that auto-places tasks into focus blocks. Each block has an affinity filter: a project focus block only fills with tasks from that project. The auto-fill engine uses a greedy algorithm that respects dependency order through topological sort, so predecessor tasks are always scheduled before their dependents. Critical path items from your projects slot in first, automatically.

schedule.caption: Generated in 2 seconds. Every task placed by AI priority score.

priority.title: 7-factor priority
priority.description: Manual rank, priority label, AI importance, AI urgency, due date, calendar fit, creation date. Tasks aren't just sorted — they're understood.

focusBlocks.title: Focus blocks
focusBlocks.description: Deep work, admin, project, personal — each block has an affinity filter. Critical path tasks always slot first.

dependency.title: Dependency-aware
dependency.description: Topological sort ensures predecessors are scheduled before dependents. The calendar respects your project's logic.

beforeAfter.withoutText: Sunday night: stare at empty calendar. Try to remember what's urgent. Manually block time for each task. Get interrupted. Reschedule everything.
beforeAfter.withText: "Plan my day." Review the proposed schedule. Drag one block to adjust. Approve.

closing.tagline: Motion auto-schedules without asking. HABOS proposes — you decide.
